title: Simulation Task
description: Develop a multi-agent simulation system that models the spread of mask-wearing behavior through social networks.
simulation_focus: Predict agents' mask-wearing behavior over day 30 - day 39 (last ten days) based on their attributes, social connections, and past behavior
Model information propagation and behavioral changes triggered by social influence and government intervention starting on Day 10

data_files.agent_attributes.csv: Contains demographic and behavioral attributes of each agent, including age, occupation, risk perception, and social connection counts
data_files.social_network.json: Contains structured data representing a social network. Each entry corresponds to a user (identified by a unique integer ID), and the values describe the different types of relationships that user has with others. Data Structure: The top-level structure is a dictionary ({} in JSON). Keys: Each key is a unique user ID (as an integer, e.g., 0, 1, 2, etc.). Values: Each value is another dictionary with the following fields: "family": a list of user IDs representing family connections. "work_school": a list of user IDs representing colleagues or schoolmates. "community": a list of user IDs representing community-level acquaintances. "all": a merged list of all user IDs connected to the user across the three categories above.
data_files.train_data.csv: Time series data for the first 30 days, used for training the model

RMSE.description: Root Mean Square Error measuring overall predictive accuracy of mask adoption rates
RMSE.interpretation: Directly interpretable as percentage deviations due to the 0-1 range

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe neighbors’ mask use and update their own adoption probability based on social norms and homophily.

interactions.name: policy_compliance
interactions.description: Authorities set mask mandates or recommendations; people decide to comply based on propensity, trust, and enforcement; locations enforce requirements.

interactions.name: media_exposure
interactions.description: People receive messages from information channels affecting risk perception and attitudes toward masks.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: People purchase masks from retailers subject to stock, price, and income constraints.

interactions.name: location_interaction
interactions.description: People interact at locations, generating contacts; mask requirements and enforcement influence mask use during contacts.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Exogenous or endogenous case incidence updates perceived risk, which feeds into mask adoption decisions.

metrics.name: overall_mask_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step and at the end of the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Days required to reach the specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final N days (e.g., last 14 days).

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across socio-demographic groups (e.g., Gini or between-group variance).

metrics.name: noncompliance_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals not wearing masks in locations where they are required.

metrics.name: mask_availability
metrics.description: Share of days with adequate retailer stock; number of stockout days.

metrics.name: estimated_transmission_reduction
metrics.description: Estimated reduction in effective contacts due to mask usage and mask efficacy (proxy for transmission reduction).
